The Router's visual inspection of the boundary fusion overrides the expert's mask confidence.

The 'melting' of the bubble into the lips is a structural/topological failure (Severity ~2.5). Additionally, the human face shows mild generative smoothing artifacts (Severity ~1.5). These defects prevent the image from achieving high artifact scores, as they break the physical realism of the scene. The background and bubble interior are relatively clean, but the foreground interaction is flawed.
